headline: A mathematical-analysis preprint reports mismatches between OpenAI’s Navier-Stokes proof and cited Lean estimates
summary: Bastounis, Circelli and Hansen compare OpenAI’s natural-language Navier–Stokes proof with cited Lean declarations. For Lemma 8.6, equation (8.19), they report that the manuscript states an m+4 derivative estimate while the cited Lean estimate requires m+5. For pressure-flux equation (10.19), they report a different Lean bound and proof route, including an additional localized gradient norm. Static inspection of the pinned source shows a related canonical cutoff-flux bound is used along the option-C proof path; whether it is equivalent or sufficient for the manuscript argument remains unresolved. The authors do not claim the natural-language blow-up proof is incorrect. The critique remains an author-reported result without independent reproduction or established specialist consensus.
